source.title: Charhound's Vicious Huntbelt — Wowhead Looter cumulative disenchanting results
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated player submissions)

notes: Indexed original Wowhead Looter per-gear cumulative Disenchant table, not a time-resolved experiment. Material rows are all called Refulgent Crystal and are distinguished only by source display order, NOT verified item ID or rank. One source-shared gear denominator for this input, no independent cohort per row. Raw per-hit quantity/pctstack, exact linked material IDs, output quality, overall zero-output casts, per-cast histograms, min/max, collector dates, patch/build and skill/spec were not exposed. Live and PTR variants may mirror the same Looter table; do not double-count. Entry patch 11.2.0 and displayed selectable ilvl do not establish collection patch or actual input ilvl. Research-only: no inferred probabilities, confidence, zero outcomes, or current-game eligibility. Input 237688 (epic leather waist); material row 1/3. In particular do not read the source's unaccounted row hits as casts with no disenchant output.
